interpretation_ko: 사업 다툼에서 최선의 길을 놓고 갈팡질팡할 조짐
interpretation_en: you will be undecided as to the best course to pursue in dissenting to some business complication

cite.original: To dream of parables, denotes that you will be undecided as to the best course to pursue in dissenting to some business complication.
cite.translation_ko: 비유 꿈은, 사업 다툼에서 최선의 길을 놓고 갈팡질팡할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: this is a prophecy of misunderstandings and disloyalty

cite.original: To the lover, or young woman, this is a prophecy of misunderstandings and disloyalty.
cite.translation_ko: 연인이나 처녀가 비유 꿈을 꾸면, 오해와 불신이 생길 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 기꺼이 돕는 충직한 벗이 있다는 조짐
interpretation_en: means loyal friends, who are willing to aid you

cite.original: To dream that you are in Paradise, means loyal friends, who are willing to aid you.
cite.translation_ko: 낙원에 있는 꿈은, 기꺼이 돕는 충직한 벗이 있다는 조짐이다

context: 선원이나 장도에 오른 이가 낙원 꿈을 꿈
interpretation_en: this dream holds out bright hopes to sailors or those about to make a long voyage

cite.original: This dream holds out bright hopes to sailors or those about to make a long voyage.
cite.translation_ko: 선원이나 장도에 오른 이가 낙원 꿈을 꾸면, 밝은 희망을 준다

interpretation_en: to mothers, this means fair and obedient children

cite.original: To mothers, this means fair and obedient children.
cite.translation_ko: 어머니가 낙원 꿈을 꾸면, 순종하는 자식을 얻을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: if you are sick and unfortunate, you will have a speedy recovery and your fortune will ripen

cite.original: If you are sick and unfortunate, you will have a speedy recovery and your fortune will ripen.
cite.translation_ko: 병약자가 낙원 꿈을 꾸면, 빠른 회복과 무르익는 운수의 조짐이다

interpretation_en: to lovers, it is the promise of wealth and faithfulness

cite.original: To lovers, it is the promise of wealth and faithfulness.
cite.translation_ko: 연인이 낙원 꿈을 꾸면, 부와 신의를 약속받을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 그럴듯해 보이는 사업이 실망스럽게 끝날 조짐
interpretation_en: you will undertake enterprises which look exceedingly feasible and full of fortunate returns, but which will prove disappointing and vexatious

cite.original: To dream that you start to Paradise and find yourself bewildered and lost, you will undertake enterprises which look exceedingly feasible and full of fortunate returns, but which will prove disappointing and vexatious.
cite.translation_ko: 낙원으로 가다 헤매고 길을 잃는 꿈은, 그럴듯해 보이는 사업이 실망스럽게 끝날 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 재정적 손실과 문필의 실망을 겪을 흉조
interpretation_en: paralysis is a bad dream, denoting financial reverses and disappointment in literary attainment

cite.original: Paralysis is a bad dream, denoting financial reverses and disappointment in literary attainment.
cite.translation_ko: 마비에 걸리는 꿈은, 재정적 손실과 문필의 실망을 겪을 흉조다

interpretation_en: to lovers, it portends a cessation of affections

cite.original: To lovers, it portends a cessation of affections.
cite.translation_ko: 연인이 마비에 걸리는 꿈은, 애정이 식어갈 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream of a parasol, denotes, for married people, illicit enjoyments.
cite.translation_ko: 기혼자가 양산 꿈을 꾸면, 부적절한 즐거움을 누릴 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 여러 밀회에 빠져 애인에게 들킬까 조마조마할 조짐
interpretation_en: she will engage in many flirtations, some of which will cause her interesting disturbances, lest her lover find out her inclinations

cite.original: If a young woman has this dream, she will engage in many flirtations, some of which will cause her interesting disturbances, lest her lover find out her inclinations.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 양산 꿈을 꾸면, 여러 밀회에 빠져 애인에게 들킬까 조마조마할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 뜻밖에 반가운 사람이 돌아오거나 보살핌을 받을 조짐
interpretation_en: you will be pleasantly surprised by the return of some absent one, or be cared for in a worldly way

cite.original: To dream of a parcel being delivered to you, denotes that you will be pleasantly surprised by the return of some absent one, or be cared for in a worldly way.
cite.translation_ko: 제게 소포가 배달되는 꿈은, 뜻밖에 반가운 사람이 돌아오거나 보살핌을 받을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: you will have some unpleasant task to perform

cite.original: If you carry a parcel, you will have some unpleasant task to perform.
cite.translation_ko: 소포를 나르는 꿈은, 달갑잖은 일을 해야 할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: you will see some deal fail to go through

cite.original: To let a parcel fall on the way as you go to deliver it, you will see some deal fail to go through.
cite.translation_ko: 소포를 배달하다 길에서 떨어뜨리는 꿈은, 어떤 거래가 틀어질 조짐이다
